data.noteCertificate: The project had received BU in December 2017, hence was an ongoing project when it was registered. The SBI drop down OD account was only used as designated RERA account and all transactions were routed through the same. Hence the closing balance would be negative since its an OD account. But since the system does not allow negative figures, the figures as per the CA certificate are correct and matching as per bank statement. The amount of deposits and withdrawals are correctly mentioned in form 3 online.
